subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: Should this be handled as Feishu bot/app permission diagnostics, account-routing cleanup, or new user-token behavior for Bitable table operations after app replacement?
rationale: The source confirms the app-credential path, but without the live Feishu error body/code/log_id, changing auth or account precedence would be a compatibility- and security-sensitive guess.

options.title: Collect live Feishu error first
options.body: Ask for or run a redacted live repro that captures the HTTP body, Feishu code, and log_id before changing auth or routing behavior.

options.title: Improve app-scope diagnostics
options.body: If the Feishu response proves this is bot/app permission or resource sharing, keep bot-token behavior and add clearer diagnostics or setup guidance.

options.title: Design user-token support
options.body: If Feishu requires user authorization for the affected table operations, define a user-token storage/config/security design before implementation.

recommendation.title: Collect live Feishu error first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a redacted live repro that captures the HTTP body, Feishu code, and log_id before changing auth or routing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community maintainer, making them the best first routing candidate for the Feishu-specific auth behavior decision.
